events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married John Yonges (license 24 July 1622: John Yonges, bachelor, and Joan Herrington of Southwold, spinster; bond by Mr. Christopher Yongs) [R4-S1]

bio: Joan Herrington was married by licence at Southwold, Suffolk, England, on 25 July 1622. A history of the Youngs family suggests she may have been a daughter of the Stephen Herrington named in the will of Thomas Warren. She died in England about 1630. She is placed as John's 11th-great-grandmother, but on present evidence that descent is doubtful.
sources: [R4-S1] Selah Youngs Jr., Youngs Family: Vicar Christopher Yonges, his ancestors in England and his descendants in America (1907), pp. 38-41 (First and Second Generations) (secondary) https://archive.org/details/youngsfamilyvica00youn
researchNotes: Youngs Family (1907) gives the 1622 marriage and license, and suggests she may have been a daughter of the Stephen Herrington named in Thomas Warren's will. She died in England about 1630 ([R4-S1]). Not ancestral on present evidence.
summary: Joan Herrington, married by licence at Southwold, Suffolk, in 1622 and died in England about 1630; placed as John's 11th-great-grandmother, though the descent is doubtful.
